objective: Refactor the benchmark and validate every integrated model on a fixed subset, tracing paper reproduction to matched historical samples.
scope_note: Subset validation covers integration and matched populations; it does not establish full-paper table or bitwise generation reproduction. Detailed local execution records are excluded from source control.

models.provenance_limit: Need an actual reference-conditioned checkpoint, strict complete weight loading and native reference inference before canary/full16 generation. Configuring n_speakers=0 does not create missing trained weights or supply reference spectrograms.
Local HF cache has 1 of 15 required shards; no model inference. Interface tests and live API imports do not establish reference speaker cloning or subset reproduction.

Local main/AudioVAE/tokenizer weights and upstream source hashed. Requested and effective native retry seeds recorded. Existing historical 0.5B short10 CPU run requires a separate protocol/subset; no cross-version substitution.
Initial subset run predates auxiliary source/config/embedding fingerprint repair; implicit Melo/BERT downloads still require runtime asset capture.

Pinned local model/vocoder snapshots and upstream source fingerprints; historical run lacks immutable weight/runtime records. Corrected generation predates invalid-tokenizer validation guard. Native and CLI are distinct timing protocols.
Historical HTTP result has matched input/audio hashes, but lacks immutable server weights/runtime and server-side seeds. Native serial is a separate implementation.
Owned pinned official service and independently checked local weights; historical server weights/runtime/seeds unavailable. Cold-start repeatability remains unresolved.
Validated isolated overlay, not a clean environment lock. Historical run lacks immutable weight/runtime records. Generation run predates expanded upstream distribution closure capture.

Validated overlay, not a clean environment lock. Explicit main/tokenizer snapshots. Historical log omits reference_role; assistant inferred from preceding source edc38f4. Current YAML explicitly uses user. Historical weights/runtime immutable records absent.

Configured primary and YAML-referenced ASR/F0/PL-BERT assets captured. Other implicit Hub assets and historical immutable weight/runtime records remain incomplete. Serial scoped loader compatibility; no thread-safety claim.

Historical checkpoint directory the original checkpoint directory is absent; replacement weight equivalence unproven. Configured checkpoint/frontend/config assets hashed. Installed-package normalizer FST caches are not hashed. Campplus ONNX falls back to CPU because CUDA 11 libraries are absent; generation LLM uses CUDA. Shared tested runtime, not a clean environment lock.

Current adapter prioritizes reference text and uses dataset speaker IDs without reference-audio conditioning. Missing wrapper and configured assets prevent runtime validation; no unrelated model substitution.

Local main/Whisper/detokenizer/vocoder/GLM-tokenizer weights and upstream Python hashed. Supplemental native kernel source audit; clean install and historical reference unverified. Reference-history conditioning does not establish effective voice cloning.

Current MGM model/auxiliary checkpoint snapshot and repo_root source hashed; historical immutable Hub revision/runtime absent, so weight equivalence unproven. Key environment pins validated in existing runtime, not a clean lock. Content failure samples are retained.

Current native MossTTSD checkpoint differs from the legacy Asteroid loader architecture. Historical immutable weights/runtime absent; weight equivalence unproven. Validated Transformers 5.0.0 overlay and key-pin recipe are not a clean environment lock. Reference ASR uses a hashed local base.en checkpoint; historical ASR weight equivalence unproven.

Validated existing isolated environment, not a clean installation lock. Explicit local main checkpoint and codec include Python implementation hashes. Historical run lacks immutable weights/runtime records.

Explicit local main/DAC/speaker weights and native Python source hashed. Normalizer cache/data and native kernels not fully frozen; historical immutable weights/runtime and timing equivalence unproven. Source-index and legacy-fixed native seed variants retained. Fixed native seed almost entirely accounts for the MCD mean gap; no historical bitwise equivalence claim.
Six configured local preset files and upstream code hashed; historical immutable Hub revision/runtime absent. NLTK tagger resource unrecorded; key runtime pins are not a clean installation lock.
Native frozen subset measured; no historical Bark matched reference established. Environment recipe is not a clean install lock.

Configured main/codec weights and upstream lexicon/source hashed; historical immutable weights/runtime unavailable. G2P/NLTK package resources not frozen; key pins are not a clean installation lock. Runtime explicitly moves main model and both codecs to requested device; historical timing/device equivalence unproven.

Current local checkpoint and source hashed; historical immutable weights/runtime and effective attention backend unproven. Current generation uses SDPA fallback because flash-attn is absent. Validated key runtime pins are not a clean installation lock. Matched historical scoring uses lowercase_v1 WER.

requirements.item: Explicit backend requests and results with deterministic resource cleanup
Original sample seed propagation including subprocess and HTTP adapters
Preserve manifest variants and select historical protocol explicitly
Fixed subset with input hashes and matched historical population
Independently loaded versioned scorers with sample-level metric recovery
Dependency-scoped code, weights, worker environments and hardware provenance
Protocol and stage plan for protection, denoising, generation and scoring
Separate completion, protocol validity and cross-run comparability
Speaker-aware paired comparison and consistent timing provenance
Every integrated model: real generation, scoring, historical comparison where supported
CLI, documentation, website and HF integration with full checks

caveats: Subset checks do not establish full-paper table reproduction.
Historical results lacking weight revisions or seeds cannot establish bitwise generation equivalence.
Historical source data and result artifacts remain preserved.
